mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND gmt_create >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem w JOIN status_node sn ON w.status_node_id = sn.id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.gmt_create >= #{since} AND sn.category = 'DONE'

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, gmt_create, gmt_modified)), 0) FROM dispatch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND gmt_create >= #{since} AND is_deleted = 0 AND agent_id = #{agentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND gmt_create >= #{since}

SELECT DATE(usage_at) as day, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) as tokens FROM dispatch_ai_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_at >= #{since} AND agent_id = #{agentId} GROUP BY DATE(usage_at) ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 7
SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.name FROM agent a JOIN dispatch d ON a.id = d.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND d.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.name
